name: SpankBang
summary: Viewer-favorite free tube prized for long-form HD and 4K uploads, crisp animated hover previews, and dense user-curated playlists.
ranking_rationale: Stronger long-form HD/4K availability and playlist discovery than most free rivals, balanced by aggressive pop-under redirects and frequent DMCA removals.

pricing.free_tier: Free HD/4K streaming and community playlists with ads
pricing.notes: Free ad-supported access with no subscription paywall for 1080p or 4K playback.

pros: High proportion of full-length HD and 4K uploads
Responsive hover previews make scanning scenes fast
Deep community-curated playlists for niche tastes
cons: Aggressive pop-under and redirect ads without ad-blocking
Frequent DMCA takedowns leave gaps in saved playlists
Search relevance can drift on multi-word queries

facts.value: Long-form HD/4K clips paired with deep user-built playlists
